contradictions.source: Itaq; diiugatæ quodammodo sunt adinuicem ultrices illæ. in agendo tamen quodammodo cōiugatæ.
contradictions.english: Thus, those avengers are in one way separated from each other, yet in their actions they are not in another way joined together.
contradictions.why: The English adds 'not' to the second clause, contradicting the source which states they are joined in action.
